name: eu-agents
description: EU Commission agent plugins — 30,000 staff, 21 Commissioners, 70 years of institutional knowledge, now running on your laptop.

plugins.name: eu-simulation
plugins.description: Multi-agent simulation of EU institutional processes: all 21 Commissioner personas, College deliberation, inter-service consultation, trilogue, full OLP, and compound analysis commands (mandate-conflict, red-team-college, subsidiarity-stress, timeline).

plugins.name: eu-legislative
plugins.description: Policy drafting, legislative procedures, impact assessment, comitology, and inter-service consultation. For policy officers, legislative drafters, and SecGen lawyers.

plugins.name: eu-competition
plugins.description: Antitrust (Arts. 101-102 TFEU), state aid (Arts. 107-109 TFEU), and Commission Legal Service opinions and litigation. For DG COMP and Legal Service lawyers.

plugins.name: eu-privacy
plugins.description: Full Art. 39 EUDPR DPIA workflow voiced by five specialist roles: DPO, IT architect, legal officer, IT security, EDPS reviewer. For data protection officers and IT project managers.

plugins.name: eu-institutional-management
plugins.description: Unit management, HR administration, financial circuits, and staff operations. For Heads of Unit, HR managers, and financial officers.

plugins.name: eu-trade
plugins.description: EU Trade Defence Instruments: anti-dumping, anti-subsidy, safeguards, IPI, and FSR investigations. For DG TRADE trade defence investigators.

plugins.name: eu-grants-enforcement
plugins.description: Horizon Europe grant management, infringement procedures (Arts. 258-260 TFEU), and public procurement. For grant managers, infringement officers, and procurement experts.

plugins.name: eu-data-communication
plugins.description: Eurostat data analysis, scoreboard design, press releases, Commissioner speeches, and lines to take. For data analysts and communication officers.

plugins.name: eu-careers
plugins.description: EU Careers and EPSO preparation: grade assessment, presentation coaching, and offer evaluation. For candidates preparing for EU institution competitions.
